entities.name: Artificers
entities.description: Those who specialize in working with artifacts, from mundane tinkerers to magical craftspeople; goblins produce many.

entities.name: Machinists
entities.description: Soldevi artificers on Dominaria during the Ice Age who studied artifacts of the Brothers' War; title also applied to Esper artificers.

entities.name: Stoneforgers
entities.description: Zendikari artificers who forge weapons from stones.

entities.name: Quicksmiths
entities.description: Avishkari artificers who rely on flashes of inspiration.

entities.name: Lifecrafters
entities.description: Artificers who replicate the natural world in fine detail.

entities.name: Metatects
entities.description: Artificers of New Phyrexia's Progress Engine creating artifacts that manipulate planar metaphysics.

entities.name: Phyrexian Splicers
entities.description: Phyrexian artificers who create golems merging organic and inorganic parts.

entities.name: Progress Engine
entities.description: Part of New Phyrexia home to the Metatects.

relations.quote: The Progress Engine of New Phyrexia is home to the Metatects
